detail.reason: Planner-performed replan (proactive, no executor escalation): the approved plan committed the vite ^8.3.0 bump in upgrade-baseline while no state owned the fix that makes it safe. Verified: (a) Vite 8/Rolldown lowers import.meta.url to {}.url in browser-platform cjs output, so every built CJS entrypoint throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE at module load (measured apigen-cli:test 188 pass on vite 6.4.3 -> 26 failed on 8.3.0); (b) packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks is public and cannot build at all under the branch's @types/react 19 bump (4 TS errors, no dist emitted) and its CJS/UMD bundles carry the same token. Added three states (vite-cjs-import-meta-repair, browser-package-build-repair, browser-cjs-umd-repair), moved the bump commit out of upgrade-baseline into vite-cjs-import-meta-repair so bump and fix are one commit (guard asserts same-commit-SHA atomicity AND executes the built artifacts), re-pointed gate-triage-absorbed's inbound edge, and added dod.14/dod.15 with 22 criteria. Five original goals unchanged; all pre-existing states untouched apart from that one edge.

detail.reason: Planner-performed insert-state (proactive; no executor escalation). graph-test-build-inferred (commit 4a748796) deleted the 47 explicit @nx/vite:build targets whose executor ran validateTypes; the inferred target runs a plain vite build, so the build stopped type-checking and [tsconfig-shim-removal.5] went red — a cross-state regression that re-blocks audit-graph, which accumulates the config phase. Verified before authoring: guard_audit_config.py exits 1 with [tsconfig-shim-removal.5] neg-control positive-under-mutation exit=0 as the sole red check (50 other criteria PASS); nx run-many -t typecheck fails on exactly agent-core-env:typecheck (TS5103 — script-inferred pnpm run typecheck resolving package-local typescript@5.9.3 against the repo-wide ignoreDeprecations 6.0) and decompile-cli:typecheck (TS2454 index.ts:103, TS18048 site.ts:83), 60/62 green; nx build decompile-cli fails on a cold cache (scratch NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY + NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY, 0/2 cache hit). Also corrects a falsified artifact: the claim in SHIM-REMOVAL.md that no removal changed a build outcome is false, because TS 6.0.3 defaults strict to true, so removing strict:false enabled strict for the 137 inheriting configs. Added work state typecheck-teeth-restored (phase graph, between graph-release-eslint-inferred and audit-graph) with 5 criteria, restoring the gate via targetDefaults.build.dependsOn [typecheck] plus a cacheable typecheck targetDefault and accepting TS 6 strict:true, per the architect-decision verdict (APPROVE, mechanism A). Re-pointed the inbound edge of audit-graph. No existing criterion weakened — [tsconfig-shim-removal.5] untouched and re-run by the new guard. apigen-java, the one build project with no typecheck target, is unaffected: Nx create-task-graph.js skips a same-project depends_on target a project does not have. gap-check PASS; env-pin-check --strict all 20 guards pinned.

DEFECT 1 - criterion graph-js-tsc-inferred.2 checked a specifier that does not exist. It asserted rg -q "@nx/js/plugin" nx.json, but @nx/js@23.2.1 has no ./plugin export (the real specifier is @nx/js/typescript). It went green on the nx.json // comment text, not on the registration - a meaningless check. Replaced with a structural assertion that the plugins array actually contains a @nx/js/typescript registration: node -e "const p=require('./nx.json').plugins;process.exit(p.some(x=>x.plugin==='@nx/js/typescript')?0:1)". Same stated intent (the js plugin is registered so the tsc-built projects still infer a build); not satisfiable by comment text. The nx.json // comment is left in place.

DEFECT 2 - reservation gap. The state's guard walks EVERY project.json, but the reservation omitted root project.json. Work commit 5b038916 touched 17 files = the 16 reserved + root project.json (a metadata-only description reword dropping a literal '@nx/js:tsc' substring - the same guard-driven edit graph-test-build-inferred made, and that state did reserve root project.json). Added root project.json to mutates (now 17) for retroactive accuracy. Verified no other pending state has the same guard-scope-superset-of-reservation gap: graph-release-eslint-inferred's guard-matched files (the 16 project.json files containing @nx/js:release-publish or @nx/eslint:lint) are all already in its 17 mutates, and root project.json contains neither string.

DEFECT 3 - the state's premise proved false; the measured outcome + deviations are now recorded in the state's context. The note said 'Register it, then convert the 14 tsc builds plus the bespoke build-bin'; measured, the plugin's inferred tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json cannot run here - @nx/js:typescript-sync hard-fails Missing root tsconfig.json, tsconfig.lib.json has no project references (TS6059/TS6307 against the tsconfig.base.json aliases), and its outDir is workspace-root dist/<pkg>. What actually landed: plugin-inferred targets with override-only project.json entries whose command reproduces the retired executor with the workspace TypeScript (--rootDir {projectRoot} --outDir {projectRoot}/dist --baseUrl {projectRoot} --composite false --noEmitOnError, plus trailing cp for the non-inferable asset globs), sync.disabledTaskSyncGenerators ['@nx/js:typescript-sync'], the dead targetDefaults['@nx/js:tsc'] key removed; artifact parity proven for agent-core-policy (40 files, .js/.d.ts byte-identical). Two OPEN deviations recorded and explicitly surfaced to the human for decision (NOT blessed): (1) the retired executor's clean semantics are not reproduced (additive builds; stale-file publish risk over time; fs removal inside a build command needs human approval); (2) for publishable projects dist/package.json is now materialized by dist-manifest rather than at build time (publish pipeline verified green: verify-dist-load + publish-hygiene). Executor-class record amendment: no topology, invariant, or final-audit-coverage change.
